relay_measure: M_FRONT exact current active-direction source-support count

classes.transfer: Phi(1)=1 on reachable real-I3 class; generalized collision Phi(M)=1 for M>=1

classes.real_I3: SYSTEM_SPANNING_REGENERATIVE_RESPONSE by persistent transmitting front; M grows
causal-support system-spanning via recurrent M=1 branch; extinct branch retained

large_M_symbolic_classification.G1_RESET: for every frozen huge M>=1: M -> 1 -> 1 ...
large_M_symbolic_classification.AMPLIFY: for every frozen huge M: M -> M+1 and continues increasing
large_M_symbolic_classification.PERIOD12: for every frozen huge M>=2: M -> 1 -> 2 -> 1 ...
large_M_symbolic_classification.ZERO: every frozen huge M -> 0 in one transfer
large_M_symbolic_classification.MIXED: every frozen huge M -> {0,1}; recurrent and extinct branches coexist
large_M_symbolic_classification.CAP_C: all frozen huge M exceed every frozen finite C, hence Phi_C(M)=0 immediately

large_M_scale_down: For each fixed C, M<=C transmits to M+1; M>=C+1 is nontransmitting. Exact boundary M=C+1.
relay_state_integer_crossover: For CAP_C, the transmitting/nontransmitting boundary is exactly M=C+1. This is a RELAY_STATE_INTEGER_CROSSOVER_CANDIDATE only and moves with the frozen controller constant C.
